note: Memory power the GPU reports (NVML) with a memory-copy kernel at full duty and at idle, mean over the settled rows of the measurement runs, divided by the number of HBM stacks. Dynamic power per stack = full_copy - idle.

source.repository: private measurement repository, commit 38e0926 (it contains every file below)
source.column: mem_power_w (nvidia-smi 'GPU Memory Power', memory-subsystem 1 s average)
source.rows: settled rows; full_copy = mode 'mem' rows and memsweep rows at duty 1.00; idle = mode 'idle' rows
source.H200: experiments/0922_h200/out/exp1/gpu0/h200_*.csv; 6 full-copy / 11 idle rows. One of the three H200 cards measured (device index 0); its full-copy value is the middle one (the other two cards -1.3 % / +1.6 %)
source.caveat: the copy kernel reads and writes with activations, so energies referred to it are those of a copy, not of a read-only stream
